Use the normalized coupled learners in \(def:coupled-fold-learners\), the density route in \(def:foldwise-rate-route\), and a predetermined propensity learner satisfying the generic uniform rate condition in \(def:propensity-rate-regimes\) for a deterministic \(r_{\pi,n}\to0\). Suppose
\[
r_{q,n}^2=o(n^{-1/2}),\qquad r_{\pi,n}r_{q,n}=o(n^{-1/2}),\qquad r_{\pi,n}+r_{q,n}=o(1).

\[
\mathcal B_{k,n}=-E_{P_{X,n}}\mathscr D_{\mathrm{OT}}(Q,\widehat Q)
